summary: Enhance your skills with our Knowledge Audits and Maturity Assessments Training. Gain insights to improve organizational knowledge management effectively.
lede: Knowledge audits and maturity assessments show where important know-how resides, how it moves, and how effectively it is governed and shared. For knowledge management, records and information, learning, HR, strategy, project, and digital workplace professionals, the training covers mapping critical knowledge, assessing maturity through interviews and evidence, and turning findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This training is ideal for professionals who shape how knowledge is captured, shared, and used:
audience: Knowledge management professionals and KM leads
Strategy, transformation, and organizational development officers
Program and project managers across sectors
modules: Foundations of Knowledge Audits and Maturity
Identifying Knowledge Domains and Critical Assets
Mapping Knowledge Flows and Loss Points
Analyzing Audit Data and Synthesizing Insights
